title: Undo/Redo Stacks with Structural Sharing
description: Trace copy-on-write path cloning, future-stack truncation, and reference reuse across history.

steps.label: 1. Initial State (past=[], future=[])
steps.description: Document has nodes A (4MB mesh) and B (text). Present points to Root#1.
steps.codeHighlight: const history = { past: [], present: root1, future: [] };

steps.label: 2. Edit Node B -> Copy-on-Write Spine
steps.description: Only Root and Node B are cloned (Root#2, B#2). Root#2.A === Root#1.A reuses the 4MB mesh pointer.

steps.label: 3. Undo (Cmd+Z) then New Edit
steps.description: Undo pops Root#1 to present and pushes Root#2 to future. A new edit clears future=[] cleanly.
steps.codeHighlight: return { past: [...past, present], present: root3, future: [] };
